title: Local diagnostic artifact trajectory stays replayable
description: Acceptance scenario for a local edit run with artifact, diagnostic, governance, replay, scorer, provenance, and redacted inspection evidence.

platform.rationale: The local scenario is stored as a redacted trajectory plus replay, scorer, and inspection artifacts until Platform owns cross-run storage.

assumptions.workflow: Agent performs one local edit, links a skill artifact, records diagnostics, emits governance, and finishes with cited evidence.
assumptions.correctnessModel: A successful run has deterministic replay deltas at zero, scorer findings passing, bounded tool count, and provenance anchors for the terminal tool result.
assumptions.threatModel: Inspection artifacts must stay redacted and must not leak adversarial canary strings from untrusted files or prompts.
researchBasis: Trajectory replay should be deterministic and auditable before model-level optimization.
Human labels and evidence anchors are required to turn replay artifacts into training and evaluation data.
Efficiency budgets catch regressions that pure correctness scoring misses.
